title: GAR Mod
description: This is a huge mod that adds Blueprint's GAR to Minecraft.
body:
# GAR Mod

![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.1-brightgreen)
![NeoForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-NeoForge-orange)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue)

Have you ever wondered what it would be like to be a solider in the Clone Wars? Well **GAR Mod** is the mod for you. You can explore an interactive roleplay as a Clone in the Grand Army of the Republic. If thats not for you can raid the border using blaster rifles.

## Current Features
- Assignable power
- Unique Morphs for all ranks
- Abilty to become a raider
- Custom animations
- Team GUI
- Teams

## How this works
Please keep in mind this mod is a work in **progress**! Power is currently only avaliable to be assigned by officers. In the future we aim to be able for all people to earn power over time.


## BETA VERSION includes
- Cadet
- Trooper
- Teams
- Team GUI (needs visual work)
- Raider morph (standard b1)
- Raider custom walking/sprinting anims
- Raider custom hit animations

## Inspiration
This mod is focused on creating a minecraft mod that contains some of the features from Vikinglaws Grand Army of the Republic on Roblox, **BUT** you do not have to play the roblox one, try this out you never know, you might love it.
